description: This Java source file defines an abstract Akka actor class 'AbstractPersistenceOperationsActor' responsible for handling persistence operations related to namespaces and entities in a distributed system. It manages command subscriptions, handles namespace and entity purging, and communicates with other components via pub-sub mediator. The class is part of a persistence utility package within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: AbstractPersistenceOperationsActor
classes.description: An abstract Akka actor class that manages persistence operations for namespaces and entities, including subscribing to pub-sub topics, handling purge commands, and coordinating shutdown procedures within a distributed system.

methods.name: preStart
methods.description: Initializes the actor by subscribing to namespace and entity command topics.

methods.name: postStop
methods.description: Cleans up resources by closing all registered Closeable objects when the actor stops.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the message handling logic for various command and acknowledgment messages.

methods.name: purgeNamespace
methods.description: Handles namespace purge commands by invoking namespace persistence operations and responding with success or failure.

methods.name: purgeEntities
methods.description: Handles entity purge commands, shutting down actors related to entities and scheduling actual purging.

methods.name: shutDownPersistenceActorsOfEntitiesToPurge
methods.description: Publishes shutdown signals for persistence actors managing entities to be purged.

methods.name: schedulePurgingEntitiesIn
methods.description: Schedules delayed execution to purge entities after a specified duration.

methods.name: doPurgeEntities
methods.description: Performs the entity data purge asynchronously and sends response messages.

methods.name: handleSubscribeAck
methods.description: Processes subscription acknowledgment messages from the pub-sub mediator.
